card.name: Section number digits in label headings
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in section numbers such as 2.5 or 5.4, just before a new section heading starts. Also a full stop ending a sentence about opioid titration.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: The final digit of a numbered section heading in a drug label, right before the heading title.

modes.label: Period after titration
modes.description: The full stop ending the sentence about changing analgesic requirements and initial titration, before the next sentence.
